title: Part 6 of the knowledge and team journey, the sync client: wizardingcode-mem kee
input: Part 6 of the knowledge and team journey, the sync client: wizardingcode-mem keeps a list of team servers (https URL, serverId, device token, contract) and joins one with an invitation code from the CLI and the viewer; binds a project to one server at most and chooses roots and areas per server; keys the sharing ledger and the policy by serverId, migrating part 4's ledger; syncs in the background, never on a hook path: pushes what the policy allows right after each local change and keeps one pull open per server with wait while a session or the viewer is active, applying received entries and memories to the local store with their received records, handling stale, refused, purged, rate and storage answers, instance changes, 410 and moves as ADR 0026 states; ADR 0027.
